title: Supersedes NAT-155 (its dependency on the open NAT-151 fail record cannot be met). Host: loader nat036_msg() returns its slot/site messages from a table of absolute link-time pointers (six R_AARCH64_ABS64 in ckpt3.c.o .rela.rodata); the position-independent loader faults in fail() reading them (NAT-151: FAR 0x1f935). Return them PC-relatively, and a build check that the loader objects carry no ABS64 relocation except the Image header's size
acceptance: Relocation scan of every loader object: only start.S's header quad remains
nat036_msg returns the same strings for every rc/bad (host test against the old table)
The fix applies to future loader builds without changing a pinned image retroactively; make check
